description.zh: 侧栏导航新增「置顶/未读」入口：点一下在图标下方贴左侧栏展开浮层，置顶会话（灰色图钉）排在前面、未读会话（标题旁小绿点）排在后面，标题右侧以「置顶 / 未读」双色计数（灰 / 绿）；点会话立即切换且浮层不收起，行尾可取消置顶，读过的未读会自动消失。
description.en: Adds a Pinned/Unread entry to the sidebar navigation: one click expands a floating list inside the left column, pinned sessions (gray pin) first and unread ones (small green dot beside the title) after them, with gray/green split counts beside the heading. Switch in one click without closing the list; unpin from a row, and read sessions drop out of the unread group.
